title: Paper feed tray 1 lift error
shortDescription: Tray 1 lift motor did not reach upper limit.
fullDescription:
C-0202 indicates the lift-up plate inside tray 1 did not reach its upper limit. The sensor for the lift position either did not activate in time, or the motor failed.

Common causes are a broken lift-up plate spring, a jammed mechanism from paper fragments, or a failed lift motor. On bizhub devices in dusty environments, the upper-limit sensor can also get obstructed.

Check the tray for debris and confirm the lift plate moves freely; if not, the mechanism needs servicing.

fixSteps.title: Remove tray and clean
fixSteps.instruction: Pull out tray 1, empty paper, and vacuum inside the tray cavity.

fixSteps.title: Test lift plate
fixSteps.instruction: Push down on the lift plate; it should spring back smoothly.

fixSteps.title: Service call
fixSteps.instruction: Technician replaces lift motor or spring.

whenToCallPro: If the tray plate does not move freely after cleaning.

faq.q: Can I use tray 2 while tray 1 is broken?
faq.a: Yes, select tray 2 in driver or panel.

title: Tray 2 lift error
shortDescription: Tray 2 lift motor or sensor failed.
fullDescription:
C-0204 is the tray 2 counterpart of C-0202. The lift mechanism in paper tray 2 did not raise to the pick-up position within the timeout.

Diagnosis and fix are identical — clean out debris, ensure the lift plate moves, and if not, have the motor or spring replaced.

bizhub consoles show a sub-code indicating which sensor failed.

fixSteps.title: Clean tray 2
fixSteps.instruction: Remove and vacuum cavity.

fixSteps.title: Service
fixSteps.instruction: Technician replaces motor.

whenToCallPro: If cleaning does not help.

faq.q: Do all trays share the motor?
faq.a: No, each main tray has its own lift motor.

title: Paper jam sensor inconsistency
shortDescription: Paper path sensors report conflicting state.
fullDescription:
C-1004 arises when paper jam sensors give inconsistent readings — for example, a sheet appears to arrive at a downstream sensor without passing the upstream sensor. This can be caused by a ghost sheet stuck in the path, or a failed sensor reading noise.

Thoroughly check the duplex path and registration area for torn fragments. Clean sensor windows with a cotton swab.

Persistent C-1004 after clearing indicates a sensor replacement.

fixSteps.title: Inspect full path
fixSteps.instruction: Open every door and remove any paper scraps.

fixSteps.title: Clean sensors
fixSteps.instruction: Swab optical sensor windows with a dry cotton swab.

whenToCallPro: After thorough cleaning if the code returns.

faq.a: Recycled paper with loose fibers can shed and clog sensors.

title: Transfer belt pressure/release error
fullDescription:
C-2152 is logged when the transfer belt release mechanism fails to move to the expected position. Color bizhub machines lift/lower the transfer belt from the color drums depending on print mode.

A jammed cam, a failed release motor, or a home-position sensor fault can trigger it.

This is a service-required error; mechanism access requires partial disassembly.
symptoms: Switching between BW and color fails

fixSteps.title: Service call
fixSteps.instruction: Technician inspects belt release mechanism.

whenToCallPro: Always.

faq.a: No; belt still cycles in bizhub color MFPs.

title: Color PC drive abnormality
fullDescription:
C-2253 indicates the color photoconductor (PC) drive motor — which turns the color drums — is not reaching or holding speed. The drums for cyan, magenta, and yellow are driven together in bizhub devices.

Causes include motor wear, gear damage, or a failed drive PCB.

The repair requires motor replacement and drive train inspection.

fixSteps.title: Technician diagnosis
fixSteps.instruction: Service tech runs motor test in service mode.

fixSteps.title: Replace motor
fixSteps.instruction: Install replacement PC drive motor.

whenToCallPro: Always.

faq.a: Some models continue BW-only; others halt entirely.

title: Toner supply motor K fault
fullDescription:
C-2411 is logged when the black toner supply motor current exceeds limits or stalls. It is often caused by caked toner inside the bottle or supply pipe.

Shake the black bottle, reseat, and retry. If the code persists the supply motor needs replacement.

Using non-Konica Minolta toner commonly triggers this code due to out-of-spec toner flow.
symptoms: Low toner warnings ignored too long

fixSteps.title: Reseat toner
fixSteps.instruction: Remove black toner, shake 5 times, reinstall.

fixSteps.title: Use genuine
fixSteps.instruction: Replace with genuine Konica Minolta TN series.

fixSteps.title: Professional
fixSteps.instruction: Technician replaces supply motor if hardware fails.

whenToCallPro: If genuine toner still triggers the code.

faq.a: Not recommended; flow issues cause motor faults.

title: Unsupported toner detected
shortDescription: Toner chip not recognized as genuine.
fullDescription:
C-2557 flags a toner cartridge whose chip does not match the expected genuine Konica Minolta signature. The MFP will not operate until a valid toner is installed.

This often comes from aftermarket/refilled cartridges with clones of the smart chip. Konica Minolta updates signatures periodically, so older clones stop working.

Install a genuine toner of the correct region code.

fixSteps.title: Install genuine
fixSteps.instruction: Replace with correct-region Konica Minolta TN toner.

whenToCallPro: Not needed if genuine toner is used.

faq.a: No, there is no service bypass.

title: Fusing drive abnormality
fullDescription:
C-3101 indicates the fuser drive motor did not reach its target speed. This motor powers the fuser rollers, and without rotation paper cannot pass through.

Causes are motor wear, gear damage in the fuser, or a failed driver.

A technician replaces the fuser drive motor after inspection.

fixSteps.title: Inspect fuser gears
fixSteps.instruction: Technician removes fuser and checks gear teeth.

fixSteps.title: Replace motor
fixSteps.instruction: Install new fuser motor.

whenToCallPro: Always.

faq.q: Can I just replace the fuser?
faq.a: Only if the gear in the fuser failed; motor faults need motor replacement.

title: Fusing warm-up failure
shortDescription: Fuser did not heat to operating temperature in time.
fullDescription:
C-3302 is Konica Minolta's fuser warm-up timeout. The fuser did not reach its target temperature within the allowed window, typically because a lamp has failed or the thermistor is giving bad readings.

Replacing the fuser assembly with a genuine unit, then resetting the fusing counter in service mode, resolves most cases.

bizhub fusers are serviceable as a drop-in module.

fixSteps.title: Replace fuser
fixSteps.instruction: Technician installs new fuser unit.

fixSteps.title: Reset counter
fixSteps.instruction: Enter service mode and reset fuser life counter.

whenToCallPro: Always.

faq.q: How long does a fuser last?
faq.a: Typically 300-500k pages on bizhub color.

title: Fuser thermistor open
fullDescription:
C-3722 is a specific fuser thermistor open-circuit error. The reading is so low it cannot be plausible, so the machine assumes the sensor lead is broken.

Either the connector disconnected during a recent service, or the thermistor itself is damaged.

Inspect and reseat; if no improvement, replace the thermistor or complete fuser.

fixSteps.title: Reseat thermistor
fixSteps.instruction: Technician removes fuser and checks thermistor connection.

whenToCallPro: Always.

faq.a: The machine stops, so it's safe until a technician arrives.

title: Fusing cooling fan motor failure
shortDescription: Fuser cooling fan did not spin at required speed.
fullDescription:
C-3851 indicates the fuser cooling fan has failed. The fan prevents heat buildup around the fuser by blowing air across the unit after printing.

Dust accumulation is a common culprit; the fan blade stops spinning. A full bearing failure also triggers the code.

Fan replacement is straightforward for a technician.

fixSteps.title: Clean fan
fixSteps.instruction: Technician removes side panel and vacuums fan area.

fixSteps.title: Replace fan
fixSteps.instruction: Install new cooling fan if bearing failed.

whenToCallPro: Always.

faq.q: Can I just run without the fan?
faq.a: No, risk of overheating damage.

title: Laser unit polygon motor error
fullDescription:
C-4101 is Konica Minolta's polygon motor fault. The laser scanner's polygon mirror motor could not reach the locked RPM.

LSU-level fault; the recommendation is complete LSU replacement.

A short power cycle occasionally clears transient stuck-bearing cases but is rarely a lasting fix.

fixSteps.title: Reboot
fixSteps.instruction: Power cycle for 2 minutes.

fixSteps.title: LSU replacement
fixSteps.instruction: Technician installs new laser unit.

whenToCallPro: Always.

faq.a: LSU is one of the pricier bizhub parts.

title: Write cooling fan 1 malfunction
fullDescription:
C-4511 indicates the cooling fan for the laser write unit has failed. The LSU generates heat from the polygon motor; without cooling, thermal throttling or damage occurs.

Dust accumulation or bearing wear are common causes.

Fan replacement restores operation.

causes.cause: Dust or bearing fail in LSU fan

fixSteps.title: Clean or replace fan
fixSteps.instruction: Technician accesses LSU and replaces fan.

whenToCallPro: Always.

faq.a: If ignored, yes; fix promptly.

title: Exposure lamp error
fullDescription:
C-9402 indicates the scanner (flatbed or ADF) exposure lamp is not providing correct illumination. Copies and scans are affected; prints are not.

LED modules in newer bizhub units rarely fail; older CCFL lamps do.

Scanner assembly is serviced by a technician.

fixSteps.title: Clean reference strip
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe the white calibration strip next to the scanner glass.

fixSteps.title: Replace lamp module
fixSteps.instruction: Technician replaces scanner lamp assembly.

whenToCallPro: After cleaning if code persists.

faq.a: Yes, only scan/copy is affected.

title: ADF lift motor error
shortDescription: ADF lift mechanism failed to position document.
fullDescription:
C-9501 logs an ADF lift failure — the unit cannot lift the document stack to the feed height. Cable snags, worn lift gears, or motor failure are the common causes.

Check for paper debris in the ADF tray area.

Service call is often needed to replace the lift motor or belt.

fixSteps.title: Clear debris
fixSteps.instruction: Remove any paper fragments or staples from ADF tray.

fixSteps.title: Service
fixSteps.instruction: Technician inspects and replaces lift motor.

whenToCallPro: If debris cleared but still fails.

faq.q: Can I still use the flatbed?
faq.a: Yes, ADF failure does not affect flatbed scanning.

title: HDD I/O error
fullDescription:
CD-002 is raised when the bizhub's internal hard drive reports read or write errors. The HDD stores job data, address book, and stored documents.

Replacement of the HDD and reformatting in service mode is the fix. Data loss is expected unless a backup was made.

Newer bizhub models use SSD which reduces CD-002 frequency.

fixSteps.title: Replace HDD
fixSteps.instruction: Technician installs new HDD and formats.

whenToCallPro: Always.

faq.a: Yes, back up via PageScope before replacement.

title: Firmware checksum error
fullDescription:
CE-001 indicates a firmware checksum mismatch after boot verification. Usually caused by interrupted firmware update.

Reflashing firmware from USB in recovery mode resolves it. If flash memory itself is bad, the main board is replaced.

Always use the exact matching firmware version for your model.

fixSteps.title: Recovery reflash
fixSteps.instruction: Boot into recovery, apply matching firmware via USB.

fixSteps.title: Main board replacement
fixSteps.instruction: Technician replaces main board if reflash fails.

whenToCallPro: If reflash fails twice.

faq.q: How do I enter recovery mode?
faq.a: Hold the keyboard interrupt keys specified in the service manual during power-on.

title: Network interface error
fullDescription:
CF-001 is a bizhub network interface controller error. The main board cannot communicate with the network card.

Reseating the card, or replacing it, fixes the issue. The MFP can still copy and scan-to-USB without network.

Check physical Ethernet cabling is intact as a first step.

fixSteps.title: Check Ethernet
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm link light and swap cable.

fixSteps.title: Reseat or replace card
fixSteps.instruction: Technician opens service panel and reseats or replaces network card.

whenToCallPro: If Ethernet swap does not clear.

faq.a: Yes, direct USB printing is unaffected.

title: Paper Feed Tray 1 Lift Failure
shortDescription: The paper lift mechanism in tray 1 did not raise paper to the feed position.
fullDescription: Konica Minolta service call C0202: The paper lift mechanism in tray 1 did not raise paper to the feed position. C0xxx codes are paper-handling faults; C2xxx affect transfer; C3xxx are fusing-unit faults that require professional service.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle (full)
fixSteps.instruction: Switch off using the main power switch, wait 60 seconds, restart.

fixSteps.title: Inspect tray
fixSteps.instruction: Remove and reseat the indicated tray; ensure paper is below the max line.

fixSteps.title: Clear in service mode
fixSteps.instruction: Technician enters service mode, navigates to Trouble Reset, and clears the code.

fixSteps.title: Replace assembly
fixSteps.instruction: Replace the indicated lift, transfer-belt, or fuser unit per the service manual.

whenToCallPro: All C3xxx fusing codes should be handled by a Konica Minolta technician — risk of burns and high voltage.

faq.q: Can I clear a C-code myself?
faq.a: C-codes lock the machine and clear only via service-mode after the underlying fault is fixed.
It indicates a fusing-unit warm-up issue; the unit operates at high temperature, leave it to a technician.
